Lawyers will need all the resources they can muster to cope with legal problems brought on by startling scientific advances, American Bar Association President David F. Maxwell declared here last night.

Speaking at the annual American University Law Review Dinner in the school's Mary Graydon Hall, he said the challenges of our changing times may "thrust at the very warp and woof of our fabric of laws."

Also at the dinner, Dean John S. Myers of the university's Law school, presented certificates to students participating in the Law Review Magazine.
